summary: Axos Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its subsidiary Axos Bank completed the acquisition of all U.S. consumer deposits of Jenius Bank (a digital banking business of SMBC MANUBANK) on May 2, 2026. The deal involved approximately $2.3 billion in deposits acquired for cash less a negotiated premium as per a Purchase and Assumption Agreement dated February 12, 2026. No board recommendation, advisors, or specific premium percentage were disclosed. The transaction closed quickly; the risk-arb angle focuses on deposit integration and potential cost savings.
